name: layer-rate
description: Price FDM 3D print jobs with the LayerRate calculator: a transparent quote and cost breakdown from grams, print time and your shop costs.

electricity_cost_per_kwh.title: Electricity cost per kWh
electricity_cost_per_kwh.description: Your electricity price per kilowatt-hour, in your currency.

labor_cost_per_hour.title: Labor cost per hour
labor_cost_per_hour.description: What your time is worth per hour, in your currency.

fail_ratio_percent.title: Failed-job surcharge (%)
fail_ratio_percent.description: Surcharge on the failed-job cost as a whole percent, from 0 to 100. This is a surcharge, not a failure probability.

pricing_mode.title: Pricing mode
pricing_mode.description: markup adds a percentage on top of cost. margin is the share of the sale price kept as profit.

pricing_percent.title: Markup or margin (%)
pricing_percent.description: The markup or margin percent for your prices. Margin must be below 100.

tax_percent.title: Tax (%)
tax_percent.description: Tax rate added to prices as a whole percent, for example 23 for 23% IVA. Use 0 if your prices exclude tax.

material_costs_per_kg.title: Material costs per kg
material_costs_per_kg.description: Filament price per kilogram, one entry per material, for example PLA=20, PETG=22, ASA=25.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency label used in quote output, for example EUR.
